title: Memory poisoning — the persistent backdoor
summary: Module 4. RAG poison lives for one query; memory poison lives forever. Plant an instruction in long-term memory in one session, watch it steer a brand-new session, then add write validation and provenance signing.
takeaway: Memory is an input channel that outlives the session. Validate on write, verify provenance on recall.
design_rule: Memory stores facts, never instructions; sign entries and quarantine unsigned/tampered recalls.

steps.title: Why memory is worse than RAG
